messages:
Tara (Design): Quick brain dump 1: thinking about surfacing a compact rollback CTA inside the version-history timeline. Goal: let users revert a rollout without leaving the timeline, but avoid accidental clicks.

Matt (PM): Agree. Support sees a lot of accidental full rollbacks. We want a compact affordance that is discoverable but safer than a single-click undo.

Elodie (Frontend): Idea: small inline 'Rollback' pill that opens a mini-confirm drawer (not full modal) with 1-line summary + reason optional. Drawer has keyboard focus and an explicit 'Rollback to this version' button and a secondary 'Cancel'. Drawer should be closable with Esc.

Hiro (A11y): Mini-drawer must behave like a dialog: role="dialog" with aria-modal="true" if it blocks interaction. If it's non-blocking, announce with aria-live and ensure focus stays logical. For destructive actions I'd prefer actual alertdialog semantics.

Tara (Design): Proposal: two-tier UX:
- Safe rollback: for recent quick undos (within 5 minutes) show an inline undo chip that triggers immediate revert and a 2-minute undo window (toast).
- Confirm rollback: visible on version items older than 5 minutes: clicking 'Rollback' opens alertdialog mini-confirm with required short reason input for audit.
Which feels reasonable?

Matt (PM): Sounds good. Ops wants a required reason for any rollback that changes traffic >10% or anything that reverts production. Also log user id + reason.

Elodie (Frontend): For the mini-confirm: keep it lean. Copy: "Rollback to v12? This will route users back to v12. We'll keep an undo window for 2 minutes." Checkbox for 'Notify team' optional. If required reason, show small textarea (label: 'Reason (optional)' or 'Reason (required)').

Hiro (A11y): SR copy when rollback executes: "Rollback completed: v12 is now live. Undo available for 2 minutes." Use aria-live="assertive". For the alertdialog include aria-labelledby pointing to the heading and aria-describedby for the reason/help text. Ensure the reason textarea has an accessible label.

Tara (Design): Motion: drawer slides from the right of the timeline card, subtle 180ms. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Visual affordance: show a faint undo countdown bar in toast.

Elodie (Frontend): CSS sketch for toast countdown: `width` animates from 100% to 0 over 120s, respect reduced-motion.

Matt (PM): Product rules: immediate inline undo allowed only for rollbacks that reverse last change within 5m and affect <=10% traffic. Anything larger or older requires confirm+reason. Also gate single-click immediate rollback behind a feature flag for 2 weeks.

ops-bot: Audit log: rollback v12 by tara (uid: u_231) recorded. reason: "hotfix revert".

Hiro (A11y): Extra a11y nit: ensure the rollback pill has a clear accessible name like "Rollback to version 12" and that keyboard users can trigger and cancel easily. Also ensure focus return to a sensible element after drawer closes.

Tara (Design): I'll update the Figma frames with both flows (inline undo chip + confirm drawer) and annotate the aria attributes and copy variants. @Elodie please review for layout constraints.

Elodie (Frontend): Will prototype drawer + toast undo. I'll include the aria hooks and PR notes about feature flag.

Matt (PM): I'll add the product thresholds and ops logging to the doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
